name: Lime Iro Senkitan ~Meiji Nippon, Otome Sakimorisu.~
original_name: らいむいろ戦奇譚 ～明治日本、乙女防人ス。～
source:
Around the the 37th year of the Meiji Era (1904) in the midst of the Russo-Japanese war, the small Japanese army, in need of assistance, uses its special flying (thanks to a benevolent demon) ship, the Amanohara, to attack Russia's major base at Port Arthur (Lushun).

Umakai Shintarou, a Japanese diplomat, returns from Russia and goes to Sapporo to teach at a girls academy. However, that girls academy is not typical - it is on board the Amanohara, and the five girls Shintarou teaches are known as the Lime Unit - girls with the ability to summon powerful beings to fight for them.

[Edited from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=2151]AnimeNewsNetwork[/url]]
translation:
明治37年（1904年）前後，正值日俄戰爭期間。兵力薄弱、急需援助的日軍利用特殊飛行艦天乃原——其飛行能力來自一名善良妖魔——攻擊俄國位於旅順的主要基地。

日本外交官馬飼新太郎從俄國歸來，前往札幌一所女子學校任教。然而，那所學校並不普通——它就設在天乃原艦上，而新太郎任教班上的5名少女被稱為「禮武隊」，擁有召喚強大存在為自己作戰的能力。

[改寫自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=2151]AnimeNewsNetwork[/url]]
